note: Corps campground on a Cordell Hull Lake peninsula at the end of Smith Bend Road, near Gladice. The lake loop's southwest row (sites 042-053) sits on open lawn under shade trees with the lake just behind. One wheeled camping unit per site. Cell coverage is very limited; public Wi-Fi only near the boat ramp lot and restroom 4. --Claude
summary: USACE Salt Lick Creek confirmed: 141 single + 3 group electric sites (30/50 A, water; sewer at 28), $20-32 (stored $20-32 confirmed), 2027 season Apr 21 - Oct 3 (2026 Apr 8 - Oct 4; stored Apr 1 - Oct 31 derived), showers, laundry, dump, 14-night max. PIN 1.96 km off -> 36.32020,-85.78697. WATERFRONT UPGRADE LEAD not waterfront -> lakefront (old evidence read at the wrong pin; sites 042-053 and 022 on open lawn ~25-35 m from the water).
flags: PIN: stored 36.32278,-85.80861 is the recreation.gov facility point, in unbroken forest on a cove shore ~1.96 km WEST of the campground. Catalog site centroid (145 site points): 36.32020,-85.78697, on the peninsula at the end of Smith Bend Road.

WATERFRONT UPGRADE LEAD: stored 'not waterfront'. Its evidence ('satellite at 36.321,-85.808: all developed loops sit on upland behind a continuous wide forested bank') was read at the wrong pin, 2 km from the campground, so it is no evidence. Measured from the site points on Esri (leaf-off) and 3DEP: the LAKE loop's southwest row, sites 042, 043, 045, 047-053 (~36.3170,-85.7862 to 36.3161,-85.7852), sits on open lawn under scattered shade trees with no road between the pads and the shore; pads 045, 049, 053 are ~26-36 m from the water's edge, pads at 155.0-155.3 m vs lidar water 152.4-152.8 m (~2.5 m, ~1.5 m above the 504-ft / 153.6 m normal pool) over a gentle ~8-10% bank. recreation.gov photos of 045, 049, 051, 053 show the lake directly behind the pads across open lawn; 022's photo shows a trailer pad at the water's edge (west shore). All are STANDARD ELECTRIC sites sold nightly ($26; 022 $32) and take 37-99 ft. East-side sites 055-060 and 083-089 are ~19-26 m from the water but behind a belt of evergreens and a steeper bank (pads 4-5.5 m above the water): a view. Recommend lakefront, naming 042-053 and 021-023; the reviewer decides.

SITES: stored count 150 (the facility text's '150 family sites', note prose) -> 144 site records (141 single, 3 group). Three sites (097, 104, 105) list trailers/vans/pop-ups but no RV/motorhome. Site 143 is 21 ft; every other site takes 29 ft+.
SEASON: stored 04-01..10-31 (derived, 'Approximate: Open April to October') -> 04-21..10-03 (2027 rate season and calendar; 2026 ran 04-08..10-04).
FEES: stored $20-32 confirmed for 2026 and 2027. Group sites $50 left out. Extra vehicles $5 each beyond the two hangtags (overrides the federal:usace row's 'no charge within capacity').

PHONE 931-678-4718 confirmed (recreation.gov). WEBSITE line 2 (lrn.usace.army.mil CordellHullLake.aspx) not re-read (USACE district pages answer Akamai 403 to plain HTTP per earlier batches); line 1 fine.
